title: What changed in AI for business over the past year: the technology is ready, the business is not
teaser: A year ago AI was measured by what it cost. Now it is measured by what it returns — and the return has split apart: the technology is ready, the business is not. A consolidated breakdown of twenty reports from IBM IBV, PwC, KPMG, Microsoft, BCG and Stanford HAI for 2025–2026: eight directions, 68 findings and what they mean for companies.

title: A New Era of Sport: How AI Is Changing the Limits of Human Performance
teaser: AI is turning sport into a computing system: eight discipline families, the full lifecycle, 15 working cases, and an honest look at where it fails.

title: How AI agents are starting to train robots on their own
teaser:
Robots are starting to learn on their own.

Not just to execute pre-trained actions, but to try out solutions in the real world, make mistakes, analyze the result, change their own behavior and save successful actions as new skills.

And the next step is even more interesting: a robot can accumulate experience on its own, turn it into data and use that data to train faster specialized models.

I've broken down why this could become one of the most important shifts in modern robotics.

title: AI Product Discovery: How to Automate Product Idea Generation
teaser: How to turn product idea generation from creative chaos into a reproducible system: market signals, competitors, segments, ICP, interviews, Pain Map, JTBD, hypotheses and Lean Canvas — with AI agents at every stage.

title: One Does Not Simply Ship an LLM to Production: how to manage AI systems in a company
teaser: From DataOps to AIOps: what production-ready AI systems are actually made of, and why the model alone delivers no business value.
